react/vite Plugin Integration and Local Preview

This page explains the plugins and commands needed to compile a SAX UI project, preview it with hot reload, and deploy it statically, based on the actual build scripts of codex_ui.

Toolchain and Dependencies

ComponentRole
sa compilerD:\projects\sla\sci\zig-out\bin\sa.exe (added to the user's PATH)
sa_plugin_saxThe SAX language itself: .sax → .sa → Flattener → Referee → WASM, generating app.wasm/airlock.js/index.html/app.sa
sa_plugin_reactThe React-on-SAX compatibility layer: className/event aliases, capitalized component composition, --include component-source composition; commands include sa react check/build/dev/new
sa_plugin_muiThe MUI component library source (see The mui Component Library)
sa_plugin_http_serverServes static output + SSE/chunked streaming responses; reused by the vite plugin
sa_plugin_viteA thin orchestration plugin: file-tree watching, debounced rebuilds, the /__sax_live SSE signal, reload client injection, error overlay

The vite plugin does not reimplement compilation or HTTP; it declares its dependencies on sax and http-server via sap.json; your code is physically isolated from the JS/TS build chain. Installed plugins live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\sa_plugins\installed\<name>\current; view them with sa plugin list.

Installing Plugins

# 需先在插件目录 zig build 出 zig-out/bin/<name>.dll，否则报 PluginArtifactScanUnavailable
sa plugin install --dev D:/projects/sla/sa_plugin_<name>
# privileged 插件需要 --dev 跳过手动 TTY 确认；运行时需要：
export SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1
NoteInstallation recursively rebuilds the dependency plugins listed in sap.json.dependencies (ReleaseFast); a slow first run is not a hang. Running a privileged plugin without SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 reports “privileged plugin ... is blocked in formal runtime mode”.

Hot-Reload Development: sa vite dev

Run it in the project root directory. All UI files must be passed in with --include (the vite plugin's include limit is 128 files):

cd D:/projects/sla/codex_ui
export SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1

MUI=D:/projects/sla/sa_plugin_mui
INC=""; for f in $S; do INC="$INC --include $f"; done   # S = screens/*.sax 清单

sa vite dev app.sax --react \
  --include $MUI/mui/material.sax \
  --include $MUI/mui/icons_material.sax \
  $INC \
  --title "Codex UI" --css app.css --out-dir .zig-cache/dev --port 5173

Main parameters: <entry.sax> is required; --react uses the React/SAX compilation chain; --include/-I can be repeated to append component library sources; --out-dir is the output directory (default dist under the entry directory); --port defaults to 5173; --debounce-ms is the watch debounce (default 80ms); --title overrides the HTML title; --css copies the CSS and injects a link (dev mode watches it); --public-dir recursively copies a static-assets directory. Open http://localhost:5173 in the browser and use the bottom navigation bar to switch screens.

  • Changing any .sax or React include → triggers a rebuild and pushes a reload.
  • Changing the --css file or assets under --public-dir → only refreshes the corresponding static assets, without recompiling the wasm.
  • When compilation fails, the page shows an error overlay instead of a blank screen; a successful rebuild pushes a reload event via the /__sax_live SSE channel.

Static Build and Preview

sa vite build app.sax --react --include ... --title "Codex UI" --css app.css --out-dir dist
sa vite preview dist --port 5173     # 只提供静态服务，不 watch、不再构建

build does not inject the live-reload client and produces a complete output that can be deployed statically as-is.

Reliable Single-File Syntax Verification

Warningsa vite build app.sax --react --include <one file> cannot be used as single-file verification: app.sax exits first at the lowering stage with UnknownRegister because it references undefined components, so the included file is never fully checked — such a PASS is fake.

A measured, reliable verification method: copy the target file to a temporary path, mechanically replace capitalized component tags other than the <Component> root tag with span, and then build it directly as the root:

sed -E 's{<(?!/?Component\b)(/?)([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)}{<\1span}g' screens/foo.sax > __verify.sax
sa vite build __verify.sax --react --out-dir probe_out --title p
# 通过标准：exit=0（或至少无 SA-REACT-PARSE / SA-REACT-LOWER 行）
# 验证完删除 __verify.sax 和 probe_out/

The final arbiter is still the full build (all includes together), which exposes real errors one by one. Post-change consistency checks also include: grepping component usages vs definitions to confirm there are no undefined references/duplicate names, scanning for the UTF-8 replacement character U+FFFD to catch garbled text, and spot-checking that new cxu-* classes are defined in the CSS source files.
